metadata.question: Was the aerosol optical depth higher over the Takalaman Desert in February 2020 than in February 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search Strategy: - Collection: MODIS aerosol data (MOD04_L2 or MYD04_L2 for Terra/Aqua) - Date: February 2019 vs February 2020 - Location: Taklaman Desert (Taklamakan Desert in China) - Band: Aerosol_Optical_Depth_Land_Ocean 2. Masking Strategy: - MODIS aerosol data has quality flags, but for simplicity, I'll use the main AOD band - Need to check for valid pixels and handle cloud contamination 3. Logic: - Calculate mean AOD for Feb 2019 and Feb 2020 - Compare the values - Validate that results are reasonable (AOD typically 0-3) Let me structure this: - Define Taklamakan Desert region (approximate bounding box) - Get MODIS Terra aerosol data (MOD04_L2) - Filter for February 2019 and February 2020 - Calculate mean AOD for each period - Compare and determine answer ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const taklamakan = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([75, 37, 90, 42]); // Approximate Taklamakan Desert bounds // 2. Data Acquisition const feb2019 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD04_L2') .filterDate('2019-02-01', '2019-03-01') .filterBounds(taklamakan); const feb2020 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD04_L2') .filterDate('2020-02-01', '2020-03-01') .filterBounds(taklamakan); // Check collection sizes const count2019 = feb2019.size().getInfo(); const count2020 = feb2020.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2019 Images: ${count2019}, 2020 Images: ${count2020}`); if (count2019 === 0 || count2020 === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Calculate mean AOD composites const aod2019 = feb2019.select('Aerosol_Optical_Depth_Land_Ocean').mean(); const aod2020 = feb2020.select('Aerosol_Optical_Depth_Land_Ocean').mean(); // Check valid pixels const count2019Pixels = aod2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: taklamakan, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('Aerosol_Optical_Depth_Land_Ocean').getInfo(); const count2020Pixels = aod2020.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: taklamakan, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('Aerosol_Optical_Depth_Land_Ocean').getInfo(); console.log(`2019 Valid Pixels: ${count2019Pixels}, 2020 Valid Pixels: ${count2020Pixels}`); if (count2019Pixels === 0 || count2020Pixels === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // 4. Calculation - Get mean AOD values const meanAOD2019 = aod2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: taklamakan, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('Aerosol_Optical_Depth_Land_Ocean').getInfo(); const meanAOD2020 = aod2020.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: taklamakan, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('Aerosol_Optical_Depth_Land_Ocean').getInfo(); console.log(`Mean AOD 2019: ${meanAOD2019?.toFixed(3)}, 2020: ${meanAOD2020?.toFixed(3)}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (meanAOD2019 === null || meanAOD2020 === null || isNaN(meanAOD2019) || isNaN(meanAOD2020) || meanAOD2019 < 0 || meanAOD2019 > 3 || meanAOD2020 < 0 || meanAOD2020 > 3) { console.log("C3"); } else if (meanAOD2020 > meanAOD2019) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
